notes.title: Hoshizora no Memoria -Wish upon a Shooting Star- HD Version Released
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31214042/95aeae67cc7b43cb93624d44baf98fa55a6b57b0.png

We're pleased to announce that the Hoshizora no Memoria -Wish upon a Shooting Star- HD version is now available on Steam! This includes the updated translation, the ability to change Chinami's voice between the original and Eternal Heart versions, and the engine has been upgraded to use the same one as Hoshizora no Memoria -Eternal Heart- HD. We are still polishing up the game but future updates shouldn't break saves. Chinese text will be added back in the future as a free update. If for any reason you would like to play the old build, swap over to "sd-version" branch on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/715580/Hoshizora_no_Memoria_Wish_upon_a_Shooting_Star_HD/
